```sql
SELECT SUM(r.points)
FROM main."drivers" d
JOIN main."results" r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN main."races" ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Jenson' AND d.surname = 'Button' AND ra.year = 2009;
```
